subject: Migration & deployment mode follow-up — Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@acmehealth.com>, Bob Li <bob.li@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from today — deployment mode discussion

Hi Alice / Bob,

Thanks again for taking the call today — good to walk through Acme Health's LLM plans. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Summary of needs we heard:
- Compliance: PHI and HITRUST considerations for production inference.
- Latency: sub-200ms p95 is important for real-time documentation features.
- Throughput: ~400 RPS for embeddings/semantic search during peak daytime hours.
- Current stack: experimenting with a hosted LLM API (other vendor) for prototyping; also have an on-prem GPU cluster used by research.

Deployment mode tradeoffs we discussed:
- Hosted API (Redwood hosted): fastest to onboard, no infra ops, best for quick time-to-value.
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool): predictable throughput, isolation, SLA-backed latency — good if you need throughput guarantees but want Redwood to manage infra.
- Private VPC / on-prem: full network isolation and control; recommended if you need customer-managed networking and strict PHI boundaries.

Suggested next steps:
1) Could you confirm which of the following is most important: (a) strict network isolation (Private VPC), (b) guaranteed throughput/SLA (Dedicated), or (c) fastest time-to-value (Hosted)?
2) Share a short architecture diagram or a bullet list of where inference will be called from (cloud regions, on-prem systems).
3) Procurement timeline / target go-live date so we can align pilot capacity and pricing.

I'll loop in Ethan (Solutions) to surface a quick migration plan (other-API -> Redwood hosted/dedicated/private) and provide a SOC2 snapshot and pricing options.

Attachments: none on this message.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bob Li <bob.li@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today — deployment mode discussion

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap — that matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Priority: Compliance and network isolation are non-negotiable; we handle PHI and prefer Private VPC or an on-prem option. That said, if Dedicated can meet our isolation + compliance requirements (customer-managed VPC peering + KMS integration), we would consider it to reduce ops burden.
- Latency: 150-200ms p95 is our target for the API endpoints used by clinicians.
- Current stack: prototyping on another hosted LLM provider for models and prompt experimentation; research team runs experiments on our internal GPU cluster (NVIDIA A100 nodes).
- Migration concerns: we need a low-risk migration path that avoids re-architecting our inference calls. Also need evidence of SOC2 + ability to support audit requests.

Can you send: SOC2 summary, Dedicated pricing for our estimated throughput, and a migration checklist (what you need from us for a pilot)?

Target timeline: procurement kickoff mid-August with a production pilot in Q4.

Thanks,
Alice Gomez
Head of ML, Acme Health
alice.gomez@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@acmehealth.com>, Bob Li <bob.li@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today — deployment mode discussion

Hi Alice — thanks for the specifics. Based on what you shared, here's a short options matrix and an outline for a low-risk migration pilot: 

Options summary:
- Private VPC / On-prem: Best for strict PHI/HITRUST requirements. Requires customer-managed network peering or on-prem appliance; longer setup (2-6 weeks for connectivity and compliance checks).
- Dedicated (Reserved GPU pool): Offers isolation within Redwood with VPC peering + KMS. Typical setup time 1-3 weeks. SLA-backed throughput and easier to scale.
- Hosted: fastest, but less suitable for PHI unless combined with dedicated private tenancy (we can discuss contract terms).

Pilot proposal (low-risk):
1) 2-week pilot using Dedicated capacity sized to your daytime peak (400 RPS equivalent) with VPC peering configured to your cloud account. This lets you validate latency and correctness without touching on-prem cluster.
2) If Dedicated meets latency/throughput and compliance checks, move to Private VPC for long-term production (if required).
3) Migration steps: sample payloads -> run test calls -> verify KV/prefix cache behavior -> promote model versions. Our team can provide a script to mirror calls from your current provider to Redwood during the pilot.

Attached: redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf (draft pricing), soc2-summary.pdf (high-level), redwood-migration-runbook-v1.pdf (pilot checklist).

Proposed meeting: Tuesday Aug 3rd 10am PT to review pricing and pilot runbook. Does that work for you?

If helpful, we can provide a cost comparison between continuing with your current hosted provider vs Dedicated + eventual Private VPC over a 12-month horizon.

Best,
Marissa

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today — deployment mode discussion

Hi Alice — looping in with a few technical notes and a calendar link to lock the Aug 3 meeting.

Technical notes: 
- VPC peering + KMS: We support customer-managed KMS for key wrapping and VPC peering into our dedicated subnets. For PHI, we recommend TLS+mutual-auth and a private peering tunnel.
- Migration artifacts we need for the pilot: 1) sample inference request/response traces (anonymized), 2) model config (prompt templates, temperature, max tokens), 3) expected QPS/peak hour RPS.
- If you want to reuse the same API surface, we can provide a proxy layer that accepts the same endpoints as your current provider — minimal app changes required.

Calendar: https://cal.example.com/marissa/rdw-acme-aug3-10am

I'll bring our infra runbook and a short demo showing a live traffic mirror from another hosted provider to Dedicated.

Thanks,
